description: Plain, direct English for client-facing and internal notes. Catches the tics that make text read as machine-written.

rules.message: em dash: use a comma, a colon or two sentences
bold label ending in a period before the idea: start with the full sentence
"it's not X, it's Y" contrast: state the point directly
inflated wording: say what it does

rules.pattern: \b(?:arguably|it is worth noting that|it's important to note that)\b
rules.message: filler hedge: drop it or say what is uncertain and why
